# Diet Swad

> Diet Swad is an Indian D2C healthy snacks brand based in Kolkata, West Bengal. All products are handmade, preservative-free, and priced at ₹499 with pan-India shipping. Run by Radiant Twins Enterprise.

## Products

All products are available to order at https://www.dietswad.in/order

- [Power Bites](https://www.dietswad.in/power-bites): Date and nut heart shaped energy bites. Arabian dates 53.8%, 11 ingredients, 1.1g protein per 15g bite. No refined sugars.
- [Royal Bites](https://www.dietswad.in/royal-bites): Roasted gram flour + peanut butter bites with jaggery and cocoa. 2.2g protein per 15g bite. No refined sugars.
- [Peanut-Sesame Delights](https://www.dietswad.in/peanut-sesame-delights): 4-ingredient heart shaped energy bites. Dates 50%, roasted peanuts 40%, sesame 6%, ghee 4%. 2.0g protein per 15g bite. No refined sugars.
- [Millet Butter Cookies](https://www.dietswad.in/millet-butter-cookies): Sorghum millet (30.8%) and salted butter cookies.
- [Millet Coconut Cookies](https://www.dietswad.in/millet-coconut-cookies): Jowar millet, desiccated coconut, and oats cookies.
- [Millet Choco Cookies](https://www.dietswad.in/millet-choco-cookies): Dual millet (jowar + ragi) and almond flour chocolate cookies.
- [Roasted Cashews](https://www.dietswad.in/roasted-cashews): Plain roasted cashews. 2 ingredients only. 18.2g protein per 100g.

## Blog

Educational articles on ingredients, food labelling and everyday nutrition, written for readers with no nutrition background. Research claims are attributed to named studies and each article lists its sources. Index: https://www.dietswad.in/blog/

Ingredients and sweeteners
- [Jaggery vs Refined Sugar vs Desi Khand](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/jaggery-vs-refined-sugar-vs-desi-khand): How all three are made from one plant and what processing actually changes.
- [Arabian Dates vs Local Dates](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/arabian-dates-vs-local-dates): How imported and local dates differ in moisture, sweetness and how they are sold.
- [Dates Are 70% Sugar. So Why Is Their GI Low?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/do-dates-spike-blood-sugar): Glycaemic index explained; a 2011 Nutrition Journal study measured five date varieties at GI 46.3-55.1.
- [Is Ghee Actually Healthy?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/is-ghee-healthy-myths-vs-science): Five common ghee myths answered.
- [Are Millet Cookies Actually Healthy?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/are-millet-cookies-healthy): How to tell a millet cookie from a maida cookie wearing a millet label.
- [Are Peanuts Healthy?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/are-peanuts-healthy): Peanuts are legumes not nuts, four myths, and peanut allergy safety.
- [Nolen Gur Explained](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/nolen-gur-khejur-gur-bengal): Bengal's date-palm jaggery, how it is tapped and boiled, and how to spot adulteration.
- [The Date Seed That Grew After 2,000 Years](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/methuselah-2000-year-old-date-seed): The Methuselah date palm, germinated from an ancient Masada seed.

Labels, food science and the packaged food industry
- [What Is Really Inside Packaged Snacks?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/what-is-really-inside-packaged-snacks): A beginner's guide to reading an Indian food label, including INS numbers and sugar's many names.
- [What Does "Ultra-Processed" Actually Mean?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/what-does-ultra-processed-food-mean): The NOVA classification's four groups and the marker test that separates them.
- [Why Is Packaged Food So Cheap?](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/why-packaged-food-is-so-cheap): Ingredient costs per kilogram in India and why palm oil is the pivot.
- [How India's Snacking Changed](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/india-packaged-food-health-numbers): Six documented figures on packaged food growth, edible oil use and front-of-pack labelling.

Labels and the food industry, continued
- [What Preservatives Are, and What They Do](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/preservatives-in-indian-food-explained): Why food spoils, what each common INS number does, and what a short shelf life costs.
- [Why the Same Brand Differs by Country](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/india-vs-europe-food-standards): The four forces that change a recipe at a border, and where India is stricter or behind.

Everyday eating
- [Healthy Snacks for Kids' Tiffin](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/healthy-snacks-for-kids-tiffin): A five-day tiffin plan, portion sizes by age, and how to switch without a fight.
- [Late-Night Cravings](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/late-night-snacking-what-to-eat): Why midnight hunger happens and five things worth reaching for.
- [What to Eat Before a Workout](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/natural-pre-workout-food-india): Pre-workout food timed by how long you have, using ordinary Indian food.
- [The 7-Day Snack Swap Challenge](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/7-day-snack-swap-challenge): One swap a day for a week, what changes by day seven, and what it costs.
- [Five Things Dadi Got Right About Food](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/dadi-nani-ka-khana-food-wisdom): Seasonal eating, fermentation, ghee, short ingredient lists and set meal times, with the modern nutrition behind each.

About the brand
- [How Diet Swad Started](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/how-diet-swad-started): The origin of the brand told through seven difficult questions, including pricing, shortcuts and shelf life.

Women's health (educational only, not medical advice)
- [Why Period Cramps Happen](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/why-period-cramps-happen): The prostaglandin mechanism explained plainly, and when to see a doctor.
- [Iron-Rich Indian Foods](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/iron-rich-foods-for-periods): Non-heme iron, the vitamin C pairing that improves absorption, and what blocks it.
- [Magnesium: What It Does and Where to Find It](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/magnesium-rich-foods-india): Magnesium's role in muscle relaxation and the Indian foods that supply it.
- [Ginger, Cinnamon and Fennel: What Studies Show](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/ginger-cinnamon-fennel-what-research-says): What clinical trials report about four kitchen spices for menstrual pain, with evidence quality stated.
- [Bringing Your Grandparents' Food Habits Into a 2026 Week](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/bringing-back-old-food-habits): How to actually reinstate five traditional Indian eating habits inside a modern working week.
- [How to Spot a Sugar-Coated Date Before You Buy It](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/how-to-spot-sugar-coated-dates): Four checks for spotting glucose-syrup-coated dates before buying, and what the label should say.
- [Why Two Date Bites Satisfy When Six Mithai Do Not](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/date-sweets-vs-sugar-mithai): Why whole-date sweets produce satiety that sugar-syrup sweets do not; fibre, chewing and bulk.
- [When to Snack, and How Much: A Simple Schedule](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/healthy-snack-schedule-india): The three windows when hunger actually arrives, and portion anchors instead of calorie counting.
- [Why Healthy Eating Is So Hard in India](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/why-healthy-eating-is-hard-in-india): The three structural reasons eating well is hard in India: availability, social pressure and labels.
- [What Is Really Inside Your Daily Biscuit](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/what-is-really-inside-your-daily-biscuit): Biscuit composition explained: maida, sugar and palm oil, the INS codes, and acrylamide; IARC classifications and a 2007 Lancet trial on colours are attributed with evidence quality stated.
- [10 Everyday Kitchen Foods, and What Their Labels Say](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/10-everyday-indian-foods-label-check): Ten common Indian kitchen items and what their ingredient lists commonly reveal.
- [How to Read a Food Label in 60 Seconds](https://www.dietswad.in/blog/how-to-read-a-food-label-in-60-seconds): A repeatable five-step order for reading any Indian food label in about a minute.
